questions.definition: A **snooze** is a brief nap taken during the day.
options: a long period of rest at night

questions.definition: The **tackle** in a football match includes all the players on the opposing team.
options: the players on the same team as the speaker
the players who are not on the same team
the equipment used to catch the ball
questions.answer: the players who are not on the same team

questions.definition: **To be up to one's neck** in work means to be completely involved and struggling with too much to do.

to be working efficiently with minimal effort

questions.definition: **To kick the bucket** is an informal expression for someone dying.
options: to leave a large sum of money to someone

questions.definition: **To have a nosey** is to be excessively curious about other people's business.
options: to ask unnecessary questions about someone else's life
to be friendly and helpful to others
questions.answer: to ask unnecessary questions about someone else's life
